relevancePolicy.expected: Every omitted published-list card, plus only the independently reasoned genericSupport entries. A source omission remains in the expected universe even if its format legality has changed; legality is measured separately.
relevancePolicy.precision: For each returned row, relevant returned unique canonical passcodes divided by returned count. Unlisted potentially good alternatives remain misses; no expected IDs are added after inspecting output.
relevancePolicy.outsideQualityGate: At least 5 expected passcodes among the first 8 Outside row cards, independently for every deck scenario.
relevancePolicy.otherQualityGates: Staples at most 25% of total returned cards and at most 6; zero cards outside authoritative host legality or over copy/pool limits; no duplicate shown passcodes.
relevancePolicy.scope: Full catalog from the real engine plus pinned artifact; expected sets never restrict candidate pool.

acquisitionLimitations: Canonical YGOPRODeck pages were fetched with a browser User-Agent because bare numeric page URL returned HTTP 403. Full passcode arrays were available in successful canonical HTML responses.
Domain source is community-authored and older; no tournament claim is attached to it.
Domain source does not explicitly assign a Deck Master; the derived scenario declares its own choice.
Historic tournament source legality is not assumed current. The evaluation uses the application's pinned host banlist and Domain admission policy.

Domain scenario was corrected to follow the existing sole-Side-card import convention after finding that an Albaz master could not also be a Main Deck Fusion material. Frozen generic relevance IDs were preserved; omitted source cards were recomputed for that input correction.

genericSupport.name: Polymerization
genericSupport.reason: Fusion Summons using the Branded deck's Fusion materials.

evidence.text: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material.

genericSupport.name: Super Polymerization
genericSupport.reason: Fusion Summons with either field, including DARK materials for Starving Venom Fusion Dragon.

evidence.text: Discard 1 card; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from either field as Fusion Material. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation.

genericSupport.name: Fusion Deployment
genericSupport.reason: Reveals Albion the Branded Dragon to summon its specifically named Fallen of Albaz material.

evidence.text:
Reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck and Special Summon, from your hand or Deck, 1 of the Fusion Materials whose name is specifically listed on that card. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck, except Fusion Monsters, the turn you activate this card. You can only activate 1 "Fusion Deployment" per turn.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

genericSupport.name: Fusion Conscription
genericSupport.reason: Reveals Albion the Branded Dragon to add its named Fallen of Albaz material, subject to its same-turn restriction.

evidence.text: Reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck and add 1 of the Fusion Materials whose name is specifically listed on that card from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand, and if you do, for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Normal Summon/Set or Special Summon monsters with the added monster's name, also your monsters with that name cannot activate their effects. You can only activate 1 "Fusion Conscription" per turn.

genericSupport.name: Keeper of Dragon Magic
genericSupport.reason: Searches Branded Fusion and can revive a named material shown by a Fusion Monster.

evidence.text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 card; add 1 "Polymerization" Normal Spell or "Fusion" Normal Spell from your Deck to your hand. You can reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck; Special Summon 1 of the Fusion Materials mentioned on that monster from your GY, in face-down Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Keeper of Dragon Magic" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck, except Fusion Monsters, the turn you activate either of this card's effects.

genericSupport.name: The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion
genericSupport.reason: Can substitute for the named Fallen of Albaz material and make a LIGHT Fusion such as Albion.

evidence.text: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster, but the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be correct. You can Tribute Fusion Material Monsters on the field, including this face-up card; Special Summon 1 corresponding LIGHT Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.

genericSupport.name: Dragon's Mirror
genericSupport.reason: Fusion Summons a Dragon Fusion such as Albion by banishing the listed materials from field or GY.

evidence.text: Fusion Summon 1 Dragon Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your field or GY.

genericSupport.name: Necro Fusion
genericSupport.reason: Fusion Summons from GY materials during a later turn, supporting the Fusion deck's recursion.

evidence.text: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials mentioned on it from your GY face-down, but it cannot attack this turn.

genericSupport.name: Ultra Polymerization
genericSupport.reason: Fusion Summons from field materials and later revives both materials.

evidence.text:
Pay 2000 LP; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using 2 monsters you control as Fusion Materials. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion Monster that was Fusion Summoned with this card's effect; Special Summon all its listed Fusion Materials used for its Fusion Summon from your GY, but change their ATK/DEF to 0, also they have their effects negated.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

genericSupport.name: Magicalized Fusion
genericSupport.reason: Fusion Summons a Spellcaster Fusion such as Granguignol using field/GY materials.

evidence.text: Fusion Summon 1 Spellcaster Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials mentioned on it from your field or GY. You can only activate 1 "Magicalized Fusion" per turn.

evidence.text: If you control a Level 1 monster: Add 1 Level 1 monster from your Deck to your hand. During the End Phase of this turn, take 2000 damage if you did not Normal Summon the added monster, or a card with the same name, after activating this card.

genericSupport.name: Monster Reborn

genericSupport.name: Fire Ejection
genericSupport.reason: Sends Pyro Snake-Eyes Poplar from Deck to GY, enabling its placement effect.

evidence.text:
Send 1 Pyro monster from your Deck to the GY, then, if you sent a "Volcanic" monster to the GY, you can apply 1 of these effects.
● Inflict damage to your opponent equal to its Level x 100.
● Special Summon 1 "Bomb Token" (Pyro/FIRE/Level 1/ATK 1000/DEF 1000) to your opponent's field. Each time 1 is destroyed, its controller takes 500 damage.
You can only activate 1 "Fire Ejection" per turn.
